headline: The requirement-review flagship product — reviewing requirements against project knowledge and supporting evidence — is still marked To Do in the tracker, and the analysis could not find code confirming it either way.
what_is_there: The code that came up in the search was an admin-managed catalogue of agent presets (search, monitoring, collaboration, knowledge graph, scheduling, security and help types). Nothing in it relates to reviewing requirements or assessing evidence drawn from project knowledge.
what_is_unclear: Whether any requirement-review capability exists elsewhere in the product is unresolved: the analysis only saw a keyword-selected slice of the codebase, and one supporting document it found was explicitly not about this codebase, so it proves nothing here.
suggested_action: Ask the team which part of the product is meant to deliver requirement review, so that specific area can be looked at directly rather than by keyword search.
